cobalt-spark.$description: Cobalt Spark — Primary filled action, active states, brand accent — the sole chromatic voice in an otherwise monochrome system, so it must appear sparingly to retain its charge

obsidian-bar.$description: Obsidian Bar — Navigation background — dark anchor that frames the light canvas below

ink.$description: Ink — Primary headings and body text — near-black with a barely-warm cast that softens against pure #000

carbon.$description: Carbon — Icon strokes, secondary text, UI graphics — a touch cooler than Ink for icon differentiation

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted helper text, secondary nav, inactive labels

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary icon fills, disabled-state text, low-priority metadata

frost.$description: Frost — Hairline borders, card outlines, divider lines — the structural backbone of the grayscale system

bone.$description: Bone — Card surfaces, section backgrounds, subtle elevation — the off-white between pure white and Frost

porcelain.$description: Porcelain — Page canvas, button fills, card base — the default surface everything sits on

shadow-veil.$description: Shadow Veil — Soft shadow tint used in card and button drop-shadows to imply elevation without color

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Hero background atmospheric tint — a radial gradient that briefly warms the monochrome with a cool violet glow

inter.$description: All interface text — nav, buttons, body, subheads, and most headings; the 600 weight is reserved for emphasis, never used decoratively, and the tight -0.025em tracking on 48–72px display sizes is what makes headlines feel engineered rather than typed

rogan.$description: Wide-tracked label/eyebrow text — its defining move is the 0.05em positive tracking at modest sizes, which forces the type to read as caption-or-category rather than heading; appears as uppercase or small-caps markers above content blocks
